source_groups.label: Standalone second bewitchment case and dated original square horary
claims: heading
Chap. XCIV If Bewitched
A distinct first-edition chapter considers whether a particular querent/patient was allegedly bewitched.
Printed XCIV corresponds to editorial XCV; independent from preceding general Chapter XCII.
chart_timestamp
Anno 1646 13 Martij ... h 8:3 AM
The new square horoscope is dated 13 March 1646 and displays an early-morning time apparently written 8:3 AM.
The visually printed minute notation and Old Style date need independent diplomatics/calendrical adjudication; do not normalize to 8:03 without proof.
question_scope
If Bewitched
The source asks about a suspected supernatural explanation for illness.
No independent patient records or evidence that bewitchment causes disease.
figure_assignment
Mars Lord twelfth
Lilly gives Mars ruler of twelfth in an adverse-relationship test.
Chart source statement, not an astronomical recalculation.
figure_assignment
Mercury Lord ascendant
Mercury is assigned ruler of the patient's/querent's ascendant.
Not an empirically observed health indicator.
condition
Mars twelfth afflict Mercury
Affliction of the ascendant ruler by the twelfth ruler is one proposed positive suspicion.
Historical astrology rule, not diagnostic evidence.
condition
Mars afflict Moon
Affliction of Moon by Mars is a second proposed suspicion.
Alternative route, not a second real patient.
condition
Mercury Lord ascendant twelfth
One planet governing both ascendant and twelfth is a third criterion.
Different from the direct Mars affliction.
condition
Saturn Lord eighth mischiefe ascendant
An adverse connection from eighth ruler Saturn to ascendant is another condition.
Unverified source-specific chart condition.
source_qualification
without Lord ascendant or Moon afflicted by Lord twelfth
Lilly says strong witchcraft cannot be judged without adverse involvement of ascendant, its ruler or Moon with twelfth ruler.
A negative disqualification condition that limits the preceding conjunction examples.
authorial_allegation
no strong Witchcraft
He makes a general caveat that strong witchcraft is absent without these conditions.
Not a claim that weaker supernatural causes actually exist.

source_groups.label: Specific lunar/Saturn opposition raises initial suspicion but not final verdict
claims: condition
Moon going opposition Saturn
In this particular figure Lilly reports Moon applying to an opposition with Saturn.
One astrologically adverse relation; original chart not independently recalculated.
condition
both Planets sixth twelfth
He locates the lunar/Saturn pair in sixth and twelfth houses.
Historical house position, not a confirmed illness cause.
authorial_suspicion
gave suspicion Witchcraft
He admits these conditions initially raised suspicion of bewitchment.
Crucially suspicion is not the author's ultimate conclusion or clinical proof.
authorial_context
those that asked
He refers to people who asked the question concerning the afflicted party.
Unidentified people, no source-independent interview.

source_groups.label: First-edition physical page seam between suspicion and case background
claims: source_continuation
those that asked for the Querent
The narrative about why other people suspected witchcraft continues from PDF502 to original PDF503.
This is one continuous episode, not separate patients or separate medical opinions.

source_groups.label: Reported unsuccessful prior medical treatment and deteriorating illness
claims: authorial_context
Querent some reason for it
Lilly acknowledges the inquirers believed they had reasons to suspect witchcraft.
Preexisting suspicion may bias the question; not a supernatural observation.
authorial_treatment_history
Physitians prescribed much Physick
The author says physicians had administered substantial prior medicine.
No actual prescriptions, dates, dosing or external patient records are supplied.
authorial_treatment_history
it wrought no effect
He reports that the earlier course had not helped.
Uncorroborated lack of response, not a rigorous treatment failure.
authorial_outcome_claim
Patient worse and worse
He says the condition had worsened before his consultation.
Author-reported clinical trajectory, no independent objective measurement.

source_groups.label: Explicit refusal to endorse a witchcraft diagnosis and favorable/mitigating chart claims
claims: source_internal_judgement
I positively affirmed he was not bewitched
Lilly expressly rejects the suspected bewitchment in this case.
Historical denial of the supernatural hypothesis, not a verified medical diagnosis.
condition
Mercury in a trine to Jupiter and Mars
He invokes favorable trine testimony between Mercury and Jupiter/Mars.
Planet identities/geometry should be checked against source glyphs; do not assume independent chart parity.
condition
Venus in twelfth
Venus is described as occupying the twelfth house.
Lilly uses this position in both alternate medical inferences and judgment.
condition
Saturn much elongated cusp
Saturn is said to be far from the twelfth-house cusp.
A mitigation of the earlier opposition concern.
condition
Moon applying after opposition Saturn
He analyzes lunar application after its opposition to Saturn.
The sequence after separation is essential.
condition
Moon applies unto Mercury Lord ascendant
Moon next applies to Mercury, ruling the ascendant.
Source favorable application testimony.
condition
Mercury above earth ascending Meridian
Mercury lies above horizon and rises toward meridian, according to Lilly.
Historical accidental-strength premise, not observed recovery mechanism.

source_groups.label: Recommendation to consult physicians again and authorial bodily-disease conjecture
claims: authorial_recommendation
directed again advise Doctors
Lilly says he instructed the inquirers to consult physicians again.
A reported referral, not evidence he clinically diagnosed or treated correctly.
authorial_recommendation
civilly acquaint them
He advises the inquirers to convey his proposed interpretation respectfully to the doctors.
Advice is author-reported, no second-party correspondence or clinical chart.
authorial_health_allegation
Disease peccant occult
He claims the disease was hidden or obscure rather than caused by witchcraft.
An unverified occult-in-the-medical-sense bodily diagnosis.
authorial_health_allegation
Reines and Secrets
He places the alleged illness in the kidneys or private parts.
No examinations or laboratory records.
authorial_health_allegation
occasioned too much Venerian sports
He speculates it arose from sexual activity.
Historical moral/medical inference; do not accept etiology or shame as fact.

source_groups.label: Venus and Libra house-rulership interpretations of putative venereal condition
claims: condition
Libra cusp sixth
The original judgment places Libra on the cusp of sixth house.
Historically asserted chart relation.
condition
Venus Lady sign twelfth
Venus is described as ruler of Libra and occupant of twelfth.
Derived combination used for secret disease interpretation.
historical_inference
ergo secret Disease and Venerian
Lilly interprets Libra/Venus testimony as supporting a concealed sexually associated illness.
The chart does not prove a disease or transmission route.
condition
Moon Scorpio sixth
The Moon is said to occupy Scorpio in the sixth house.
Planet position remains unrecast.
condition
Moon opposition Saturn twelfth
He restates lunar opposition to Saturn in twelfth.
Same initial adverse relation, now repurposed as disease interpretation.
historical_inference
Female Disease closely obtained
He attributes the condition to a disease contracted secretly through a woman.
Unsubstantiated gendered causal inference.
historical_inference
deed of darknesse
He characterizes the alleged circumstances as hidden or morally improper.
Historical bias, not a factual account of someone's behavior.
condition
neither Saturn nor Moon behold ascendant
He cites absence of aspects from Saturn and Moon to ascendant.
Used for hidden-nature inference, not independent finding.

source_groups.label: Reported itching, systemic localization and distinction from confirmed syphilis
claims: authorial_health_allegation
I judged he was itchy
He claims the patient experienced itching.
No direct patient interview or examination.
condition
Mercury Pisces moist Sign
He links itching to Mercury in the moist sign Pisces.
Astrological conjecture, not pathophysiology.
condition
Libra sixth Gemini airy
He groups the sixth-house sign Libra with Gemini as airy signs.
Source's associations, no independent measurements.
authorial_health_allegation
all over his Bones joints Blood
He infers widespread involvement of bones, joints and blood.
Unsupported symptom-distribution and laboratory inference.
authorial_health_allegation
Blood being corrupted
He claims the blood was corrupted.
No blood test or biological confirmation.
source_qualification
did not say perfect Lues Venerea

authorial_recommendation
caution to prevent it
He says he offered a warning to prevent or avoid a more developed venereal disorder.
Vague precaution, not a documented modern treatment protocol.

source_groups.label: Course change and three-week recovery asserted, not independently verified

authorial_outcome_claim
course of Physick altered

Actual interventions, drugs or quantities unknown.
authorial_outcome_claim

Lilly asserts complete recovery within approximately three weeks.
One unverified authorial retrospective outcome, not independent diagnosis or treatment efficacy.
